title: How to Build a Restaurant Ordering App (Without Giving 30% to DoorDash)
summary: DoorDash takes up to 30% per order. Build your own restaurant ordering app with Blink—database, auth, payments, and hosting included. No config needed.
body_markdown: Yes. Blink generates responsive apps that work on mobile browsers — no separate app download required. Your customers open the URL on their phone and get the full ordering experience. For a native iOS or Android app, ask Blink to build with a mobile-first layout and generate a progressive web app (PWA) manifest so customers can add it to their home screen.
